start_here: Say to your AI: "Check my greenhouse record library at tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/test/fixtures/greenhouse with its schema.json and tell me which checks break." It runs tool:check-a-record-library.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads your own record files through the schema file you give it and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Have a library folder of JSON record files and a schema file that names its pools, checks, tables and derived files (the README lists the schema keys; the made-up greenhouse fixture is a worked schema).

2. Say to your AI: "Check my record library". It reads the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:check-a-record-library"} and runs its command from the root of the Workshop checkout, filling in your library folder and schema file: python3 -I tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py --library <library> --schema <schema> validate

3. Read the JSON report: all_passed, passed and total, each check as true or the list of ids or values that break it (id_problems), the table cells outside their allowed values, and stale_derived_files.

4. Exit 0 means all passed, 1 something broke, 2 the schema or a file could not be read. Fix the named ids in the named files; a stale derived file is rebuilt with tool:rebuild-files-derived-from-my-records, not by hand.

worked_examples.title: A clean greenhouse library, then one with a dangling crop id
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py and run for real on the fixture in tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/test/fixtures/greenhouse: python3 -I tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py --library tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/test/fixtures/greenhouse --schema tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/test/fixtures/greenhouse/schema.json validate. It writes nothing. Then on a copy where card CD-003 in data/crop-cards.json names crop_id CR-009 (no such crop).
worked_examples.hands_back: First run, exit 0: {"all_passed": true, "passed": 19, "total": 19, "checks": {"question_ids_unique": true, ..., "card_crop_ids_resolve": true, "readings_values_in_vocabulary": true, "crop_count_current": true}, "id_problems": {}, "stale_derived_files": [], "scope": "Structural checks only: references, vocabulary and freshness."} plus a readings block (1 file, 8 cells, 0 bad cells). Second run on the broken copy, exit 1: all_passed false, passed 18 of 19, checks.card_crop_ids_resolve false and id_problems {"card_crop_ids_resolve": ["CR-009"]}.
